content.content:
---
name: hq-work
description: 'Use when a human assigns you a GitHub issue ("work on #N" or "/hq-work N"). Takes it from claim to a reviewed PR.'
---

# hq-work

`N` = issue, `<you>` = `claude`, `codex` or `cursor`, `<PR>` = PR number. Windows: `hq.cmd` for `./hq`.

1. Claim: `./hq claim N --agent <you>`. If it refuses, stop and tell the human why. Read what it
   prints: the issue, work in flight, overlapping files.
2. Context before code. Read only the docs the issue needs, then run
   `entire search "<topic>"`, `entire graph query "<task>"` and `entire brain brief "<task>"`.
   Before rewriting code you did not write: `entire why <file>:<line>`.
3. Plan inline in a few bullets. No spec or plan documents.
4. Build inside Scope, never in "Do not touch". Small commits, staged by name:
   `git add <file> <file> && git commit -m "<what the product can now do>"`.
   Push whenever you like: `git push -u origin HEAD`.
5. Verify: run the issue's Verify steps, then `./hq check` until it passes.
6. Sync with main. Not pushed yet: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main`. Already pushed:
   `git fetch origin && git merge origin/main` (never force-push). Fix conflicts in your own
   changes, `git add <files>`, then `git rebase --continue` or `git commit`. Re-run `./hq check`.
7. Write `.context/pr-N.md` (template below; `mkdir -p .context` if needed), then
   `./hq pr N --body-file .context/pr-N.md`. It pushes, opens the PR with `Closes #N` and sets
   `status:review`. Get the number: `gh pr view --json number,url`.
8. Trail: Entire opens a trail for your PR by itself. Check it with `entire trail show`, then run `entire trail ci-pr` (safe to re-run). Only if `trail show` finds none: `entire trail create --title "<issue title> (#N)" --type feature`.
9. Review, unless the issue is `size:S`: `entire review`. Fix real findings, commit, `git push`,
   re-run `./hq check`. Then `gh pr edit <PR> --add-label review:pass` and `entire trail ready`.
10. Report the PR link, check result and risks, then stop. Merge only on "ship it" (`/hq-ship`).

PR body template for `.context/pr-N.md`:

````markdown
## What changed
- <what the product can now do>

## How verified
- <Verify steps you ran and what you saw>
```
<tail of ./hq check>
```

## Risks
- <what could break, or "none">

## Screenshots
<UI changes only, else "n/a">
````

Out of scope: do not do it. Write `.context/new-issue.md` with the headings `### Goal`,
`### Acceptance criteria`, `### Scope`, `### Do not touch`, `### Blocked by`, `### Verify`,
`### Notes` (say "Found while working on #N" in Notes), then
`gh issue create --title "<title>" --body-file .context/new-issue.md --label status:needs-human`.
Link it on your issue: `gh issue comment N --body "Follow-up: #M"`. Carry on with your own scope.

Stuck (unclear criteria, waiting on another issue, a conflict in code you did not write):
`./hq release N --needs-human --note "<one crisp question>"`, then stop.

Done means: every acceptance criterion met, `./hq check` passes with its tail in the PR, PR open
with evidence, `review:pass` (unless `size:S`).

# claude-code review

Effort level: medium was reused from your last run. Type a level (for example `/code-review high`) to change it.

Verdict: request changes. The new "Report for the council" card counts nights whose log changed after anchoring, and it sits beside the existing server-side council report without using it.

- [medium] `apps/mobile/src/features/evidence/model.ts:19`: `isAnchored` only checks `memoSignature !== null`, so `buildReport` counts a night even after its log has changed since anchoring. The server's `report` in `apps/server/src/features/evidence/service.ts:99` rejects that case: it drops the memo unless `hash === hashLog(record)`. The card even shows "Mismatch" on such a night, but its events and wake-ups still go into the totals under the note "Counts come from your anchored nights". Fix: leave out nights whose check came back `mismatch`, or take the anchored and still-matching state from the server.
- [medium] `apps/mobile/src/features/evidence/components/ReportCard.tsx:8`: this card is titled "Report for the council" but only adds up counts on the phone. The existing `evidence.report` endpoint (#72) already returns the construction events and the draft complaint, with the same anchored-and-matching check. Users will expect the complaint text and won't find it. The client also now has a second, different idea of what "the report" covers. Fix: call `client.evidence.report` for each anchored night (or open a follow-up issue for that), or rename the card to something like "Anchored nights summary".
- [low] `apps/server/src/features/evidence/service.ts:146`: `verify` puts the stored `signature` into a `mismatch` result even when the memo read back is not for this night (`anchoredHash` comes back null). The card only shows "Anchored ..." when `anchoredHash` is set, so the user sees "Mismatch" and a single "Now ..." hash with no reason why. Fix: show a line such as "The memo does not belong to this night" when the status is mismatch and `anchoredHash` is null.
- [low] `apps/mobile/src/features/evidence/screens/EvidenceScreen.tsx:23`: `onVerify` keeps the previous result when a new check starts. If the re-check fails, the card shows the old "Match" result next to "We could not check this night", so it looks verified when the latest check failed. Fix: also clear `results[nightId]` when setting the state to `"pending"`.
- [low] `apps/mobile/src/features/evidence/screens/EvidenceScreen.tsx:64`: `ReportCard` appears whenever any night exists, even if none is anchored. It then reads "0 anchored nights: 0 noise events, 0 outside the council's recommended hours, 0 wake-ups." Fix: render it only when `buildReport(nights).nights > 0`.
- [low] `apps/mobile/src/features/evidence/model.ts:4`: `EXPLORER_TX` and `explorerUrl` rebuild the Solana Explorer link on the phone. The server already returns `explorerUrl` in `anchorOutput` and `verifyOutput` (`packages/shared/src/evidence/schema.ts`). If the server's link changes (a cluster parameter, a different explorer), the app keeps opening the old one. Fix: use the server-provided URL, or move one shared constant into `packages/shared/src/evidence`.
- [low] `apps/mobile/src/features/evidence/copy.ts:5`: `REPORT_NOTE` says "Noise levels are relative dB from the phone microphone", but the card shows no dB values. Fix: drop that sentence, or show the dB figures it describes.
- [low] `apps/mobile/src/features/evidence/screens/EvidenceScreen.tsx:52`: if `night.list` fails with `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, this screen shows "We could not load your nights". The Night and Attribution screens instead check for `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` with `isStub` and fall back to labelled simulated data. On a stub backend, Evidence is the only screen that errors. Fix: check for the stub the same way and show the labelled fixture or the empty state.
- [low] `apps/mobile/src/features/evidence/evidence.test.ts:14`: no test covers a night whose log changed after anchoring, `verifyHeadline`, or `plural` at n=1. The first defect above went unnoticed because of that gap. Fix: add a `buildReport` case for a mismatched night and a `plural` case for one item.
